newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stanbic appoints two new directors.
newsitem.headline: Stanbic appoints two new directors.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd has appointed two new executive directors, the company said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement Jacko Maree and Pieter Prinsloo had been appointed to the new positions. Currently the group chief executive Mike Vosloo is the only executive director.

Their appointments take effect from May 1. Maree is currently managing director of Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank while Prinsloo is executive vice-chairman and chief executive of Standard Bank London.
